answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can tie earning power to a verifiable work ledger: every agent starts on a narrow ledge of trust, able to take only tiny paid tasks. Completed work, checked by independent peers, slowly raises its limit, like a glacier carving a channel grain by grain, while failures and disputes cut it back. Reputation is non-transferable and decays without fresh work, so an attacker must pay the full cost of real, checked labour for each fake identity instead of cloning one marble of credibility into a thousand copies.
